question: How many leap days has a single Norwegian mother given birth on?
answer: Three. Karin Henriksen had Heidi on 29 February 1960, Olav on 29 February 1964 and Leif-Martin on 29 February 1968, none of them induced or by caesarean. Any one birth has about a 1-in-1,461 chance of landing on a leap day. The family has held a Guinness record since 1980.
